blocks.text: The documentation distinguishes module, final-answer, and artifact validation and explains why each receives an already-parsed value. It also documents the separate content-policy classifier.
blocks.title: Three output choke points

blocks.text: Worker threads receive an event loop before Guardrails runs. ModuleCodeNonEmpty rejects blank strings and the code-writer failure marker, while the lazy guard and validator return a caller-facing reason.
blocks.title: Module-code guard

blocks.text: FinalAnswerWellFormed rejects empty answers, leaked deduplication markers, and unbalanced fences. The cached answer guard exposes the same boolean-and-reason interface.
blocks.title: Final-answer guard

blocks.text: The old get_guard name explicitly raises. ArtifactEntryWellFormed checks a decoded object and its type, code, and optional title; validate_artifact_entry serializes the entry before invoking the reusable guard.

purpose: The module wraps cheap structural checks in reusable Guardrails validators and uses a local Laya classifier for content policy. Each validator returns a boolean and reason so callers can keep their existing fail-open fallback behavior.
